biography: Carlos Antunes grew up amidst the vibrant chaos of São Paulo, Brazil, the son of a mechanic who instilled in him a love for engines and speed. His early days were spent tinkering in his father's garage, learning the intricacies of engine tuning before he even reached his teens. A pivotal moment came during a local karting event where, at the age of 14, Carlos salvaged a broken-down kart and, against all odds, not only got it running but also won the race. This victory ignited a fire in him, solidifying his determination to become a professional racer. After a successful stint in Formula Brazil, Carlos made the jump to prototype racing, signing with MetalMoro MRX Honda P3. Now, at 22, Antunes is considered a rising star, known for his calculated approach and relentless drive to improve, meticulously analyzing telemetry data to extract every last ounce of performance.
drivingStyle: Antunes possesses a meticulously calculating driving style, often described as 'smooth aggression.' He rarely makes rash moves, preferring to set up overtakes with strategic precision rather than relying on outright daring. He excels at tire management, conserving his rubber during the initial phases of a race before unleashing his full potential in the closing laps. Under pressure, Antunes remains remarkably composed, his focus laser-locked on the task at hand, making him a formidable opponent in wheel-to-wheel combat.

rivalries.reason: A fierce competitor from their karting days, their clashes are legendary, often ending in dramatic finishes and heated exchanges.
Tanaka, known for his aggressive driving, often clashes with Antunes' calculated approach, leading to on-track confrontations.
Dubois, a veteran driver, has publicly dismissed Antunes' talent, leading to a personal and professional rivalry fueled by mutual disrespect.

quirks: Always wears the same pair of socks his grandmother knitted for him before every race.
Spends exactly 15 minutes meditating before entering the car, visualizing the perfect lap.
Refuses to eat anything yellow on race day, believing it brings bad luck.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about taking risks; it's about calculating them perfectly."
careerHighlight: Winning the Brazilian Prototype Championship in 2022 after a season-long battle with veteran drivers, showcasing his immense potential.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead at Interlagos in 2023 due to a mechanical failure, costing him a potential victory on home soil.
